description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller named RideController that manages ride-related HTTP endpoints, allowing creation and retrieval of ride data via RideRequestService.

classes.name: RideController
classes.description: A REST controller providing endpoints for creating rides and fetching ride information.

methods.name: createRide
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new ride using provided RideCreateRequest data.

methods.name: getRide
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a ride by its ID.

methods.name: getAllRides
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all rides.

methods.name: getRidesByUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve rides associated with a specific user ID.
